ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Aastha Spintex Limited reported a fire incident at its Halvad Ginning Unit on October 9, 2026, which was promptly brought under control and extinguished. While the damage is covered by insurance, the financial loss, extent of damage, and estimated impact on production remain *under evaluation*, posing a key uncertainty regarding the immediate operational and financial health of the unit. The exact cause of the fire is currently under investigation.
